LIVRARE COMPLETĂ CU BON let deliveryCartItems = []; function openDeliveryCartModal() { deliveryCartItems = []; const sel = document.getElementById('delivery-cart-product'); if (sel) sel.innerHTML = stock.map(p => '').join(''); renderDeliveryCart(); document.getElementById('delivery-cart-modal').style.display = 'flex'; } function closeDeliveryCartModal() { document.getElementById('delivery-cart-modal').style.display = 'none'; } function addToDeliveryCart() { const productId = parseInt(document.getElementById('delivery-cart-product').value); const qty = parseInt(document.getElementById('delivery-cart-qty').value) || 0; const p = stock.find(s => s.id === productId); if (!p || !qty) return; if (qty > p.qty) { setFeedback('Stoc insuficient: ' + p.qty + ' ' + p.unit + ' disponibil!', 'err'); return; } const existing = deliveryCartItems.find(i => i.productId === productId); if (existing) existing.qty += qty; else deliveryCartItems.push({ productId, name: p.name, qty, unit: p.unit, price: p.price_sell || 0 }); renderDeliveryCart(); } function renderDeliveryCart() { const el = document.getElementById('delivery-cart-list'); if (!el) return; const total = deliveryCartItems.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qty * i.price, 0); el.innerHTML = deliveryCartItems.map((item, i) => '
' + '' + item.name + ' x' + item.qty + '' + '' + (item.qty * item.price).toFixed(0) + ' RON' + '' + '
').join('') + (total > 0 ? '

Bon generat pentru ' + clientName + '.'); } // 3. INVENTAR RAPID PARȚIAL function openPartialInventory(filterBy) { const filtered = filterBy ? stock.filter(p => (p.cat || 'General') === filterBy || (p.loc || '') === filterBy) : stock; const el = document.getElementById('partial-inv-list'); if (!el) return; el.innerHTML = filtered.map(p => '

'+' : '') + diff + ' ' + p.unit + ' ajustare inventar', diff > 0 ? TRANSFER ÎNTRE RAFTURI function transferBetweenRacks(productId, fromRack, toRack) { const p = stock.find(s => s.id === productId); if (!p) return; const oldLoc = p.loc || 'Nedefinit'; p.loc = toRack; if (typeof trackLocationChange === 'function') trackLocationChange(p, toRack); saveStockToFirebase(); renderStock(); addLog('Transfer raft: ' + p.name, oldLoc + ' → ' + toRack, 'in'); setFeedback(p.name + ' mutat: ' + oldLoc + ' → ' + toRack, 'ok'); speak(p.name + ' mutat in raftul ' + toRack + '.'); } // 5. COMANDĂ FURNIZOR PDF PROFESIONAL async function generateSupplierOrder() { const lowProducts = stock.filter(p => p.qty <= p.min && p.supplier); if (!lowProducts.length) { setFeedback('Niciun produs sub minim cu furnizor definit!', 'warn'); return; } const {jsPDF} = window.jspdf; const doc = new jsPDF(); const depot = userProfile ? userProfile.depot : 'Depozit'; const now = new Date(); const orderNo = 'CMD-' + now.getTime().toString().slice(-6); doc.setFillColor(10, 12, 15); doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 40, 'F'); doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold'); doc.setFontSize(20); doc.setTextColor(232, 236, 240); doc.text('COMANDĂ FURNIZOR', 14, 22); doc.setFontSize(10); doc.setTextColor(0, 229, 160); doc.text(orderNo + ' · ' + now.toLocaleDateString('ro-RO') + ' · ' + depot, 14, 32); const grouped = {}; lowProducts.forEach(p => { const sup = p.supplier || 'Necunoscut'; if (!grouped[sup]) grouped[sup] = []; const toOrder = Math.max(p.moq || p.min * 3, p.min * 3 - p.qty); grouped[sup].push({ ...p, toOrder }); }); let yPos = 50; Object.entries(grouped).forEach(([supplier, products]) => { doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold'); doc.setFontSize(13); doc.setTextColor(255, 165, 2); doc.text('Furnizor: ' + supplier, 14, yPos); if (products[0].supplier_contact) { doc.setFontSize(9); doc.setTextColor(107, 122, 141); doc.text('Contact: ' + products[0].supplier_contact, 14, yPos + 6); yPos += 4; } yPos += 8; doc.autoTable({ startY: yPos, head: [['Produs', 'Stoc Actual', 'Stoc Min', 'De Comandat', 'UM', 'MOQ']], body: products.map(p => [p.name, p.qty, p.min, p.toOrder, p.unit, p.moq || '-']), styles: { fontSize: 9, textColor: [153, 168, 184], fillColor: [17, 20, 24] }, headStyles: { fillColor: [10, 12, 15], textColor: [0, 229, 160], fontStyle: 'bold' }, margin: { left: 14, right: 14 } }); yPos = doc.lastAutoTable.finalY + 12; }); doc.save(orderNo + '_Comanda_Furnizor.pdf'); setFeedback('Comanda furnizor generata: ' + orderNo, 'ok'); speak('Comanda furnizor generata cu succes.'); } // 6. RETUR FURNIZOR function openReturnToSupplierModal() { const el = document.getElementById('return-supplier-product'); if (el) el.innerHTML = stock.map(p => '').join(''); document.getElementById('return-supplier-modal').style.display = 'flex'; } function closeReturnToSupplierModal() { document.getElementById('return-supplier-modal').style.display = 'none'; } function confirmReturnToSupplier() { const productId = parseInt(document.getElementById('return-supplier-product').value); const qty = parseInt(document.getElementById('return-supplier-qty').value) || 0; const reason = document.getElementById('return-supplier-reason').value.trim() || 'Retur furnizor'; const p = stock.find(s => s.id === productId); if (!p || !qty) { setFeedback('Completati toate campurile!', 'warn'); return; } if (qty > p.qty) { setFeedback('Stoc insuficient pentru retur!', 'err'); return; } p.qty -= qty; saveStockToFirebase(); renderStock(); updateStats(); addLog('Retur furnizor: ' + p.name, 'OUT ' + qty + ' ' + p.unit + ' · Motiv: ' + reason, 'out'); closeReturnToSupplierModal(); setFeedback(p.name + ': ' + qty + ' ' + p.unit + ' returnate furnizorului.', 'ok'); speak(qty + ' ' + p.unit + ' din ' + p.name + ' returnate furnizorului.'); } // ══════════════════════════════════════════ // BLOC B: ALERTE + CLIENȚI + RAPOARTE (7-19) // ══════════════════════════════════════════ // 7. ALERTĂ STOC SUB MINIM PE TELEGRAM INSTANT function checkAndAlertLowStock(product) { if (!userProfile || !userProfile.telegram_id) return; if (product.qty === 0) { sendTelegramAlert('EPUIZAT: ' + product.name + ' — stoc zero! Depozit: ' + userProfile.depot, userProfile.telegram_id); } else if (product.qty <= product.min) { sendTelegramAlert('SCAZUT: ' + product.name + ' — ' + product.qty + ' ' + product.unit + ' (min ' + product.min + '). Depozit: ' + userProfile.depot, userProfile.telegram_id); } } // 8. ALERTĂ PRODUS FĂRĂ MIȘCARE 60 ZILE function checkStalenessWeekly() { const lastCheck = localStorage.getItem('sv_staleness_check'); const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); if (lastCheck === today) return; localStorage.setItem('sv_staleness_check', today); if (new Date().getDay() !== 1) return; // Only Monday const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 86400000); const stale = stock.filter(p => { const lastMove = log.find(e => e.ts && new Date(e.ts) >= cutoff && e.cmd && normalizeText(e.cmd.toLowerCase()).includes(normalizeText(p.name.toLowerCase()))); return !lastMove && p.qty > 0; }); if (stale.length > 0 && userProfile && userProfile.telegram_id) { const msg = 'PRODUSE FARA MISCARE 60 ZILE: ' + stale.slice(0, 10).map(p => '- ' + p.name + ': ' + p.qty + ' ' + p.unit).join(' '); sendTelegramAlert(msg, userProfile.telegram_id); } } setInterval(function(){if(typeof checkStalenessWeekly==="function")checkStalenessWeekly();}, 3600000); // 9. ALERTĂ VALOARE STOC SCĂZUTĂ let stockValueThreshold = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('sv_value_threshold') || '0'); function setStockValueThreshold(value) { stockValueThreshold = value; localStorage.setItem('sv_value_threshold', String(value)); setFeedback('Prag valoare stoc setat: ' + value + ' RON', 'ok'); } function checkStockValueThreshold() { if (!stockValueThreshold) return; const val = parseFloat(calculateStockValue().totalBuy || 0); if (val < stockValueThreshold) { triggerAlert('VALOARE STOC SCAZUTA: ' + val.toFixed(0) + ' RON (prag: ' + stockValueThreshold + ' RON)!', 'warn'); if (userProfile && userProfile.telegram_id) { sendTelegramAlert('ATENTIE! Valoarea stocului a scazut sub ' + stockValueThreshold + ' RON. Valoare actuala: ' + val.toFixed(0) + ' RON.', userProfile.telegram_id); } } } // 10. NOTIFICARE ZILNICĂ TOP 5 CRITICE function sendDailyTop5Critical() { const hour = new Date().getHours(); const reportHour = appSettings.daily_hour || 8; if (hour !== reportHour) return; const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); if (localStorage.getItem('sv_top5_sent') === today) return; localStorage.setItem('sv_top5_sent', today); if (!userProfile || !userProfile.telegram_id) return; const critical = stock.filter(p => p.qty <= p.min).sort((a, b) => a.qty - b.qty).slice(0, 5); if (!critical.length) return; const msg = 'TOP CRITICE AZI - ' + userProfile.depot + ': ' + critical.map((p, i) => (i + 1) + '. COMANDĂ VIITOARE PLANIFICATĂ let plannedOrders = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sv_planned_orders') || '[]'); function addPlannedOrder(clientName, productId, qty, deliveryDate) { const p = stock.find(s => s.id === productId); if (!p) return; plannedOrders.push({ id: Date.now(), clientName, productId, productName: p.name, unit: p.unit, qty, deliveryDate, status: 'planificat', created: new Date().toISOString() }); localStorage.setItem('sv_planned_orders', JSON.stringify(plannedOrders)); if (window.fbReady) db.ref('depozite/' + getDepotKey() + '/planned_orders').set(plannedOrders); setFeedback('Comanda planificata pentru ' + clientName + ' pe ' + deliveryDate, 'ok'); } function checkPlannedOrders() { const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); plannedOrders.filter(o => o.deliveryDate === today && o.status === 'planificat').forEach(order => { triggerAlert('LIVRARE AZI: ' + order.clientName + ' — ' + order.qty + ' ' + order.unit + ' ' + order.productName, 'warn'); if (userProfile && userProfile.telegram_id) { sendTelegramAlert('LIVRARE PLANIFICATA AZI: ' + order.clientName + ' asteapta ' + order.qty + ' ' + order.unit + ' ' + order.productName, userProfile.telegram_id); } }); } setInterval(function(){if(typeof checkPlannedOrders==="function")checkPlannedOrders();}, 3600000); // 13. VOCE MULTILINGVĂ AUTO-DETECT function detectAndSetLanguage(text) { const patterns = { ro: ['adauga','scoate','stoc','produse','inventar'], en: ['add','remove','stock','product','inventory'], fr: ['ajouter','enlever','stock','produit'], de: ['hinzufügen','entfernen','bestand','produkt'], es: ['añadir','quitar','inventario','producto'], it: ['aggiungi','togli','scorte','prodotto'] }; const norm = text.toLowerCase(); for (const [lang, words] of Object.entries(patterns)) { if (words.some(w => norm.includes(w))) { if (lang !== currentLang) { currentLang = lang; localStorage.setItem('sv_lang', lang); setFeedback('🌐 Limbă detectată: ' + lang.toUpperCase(), 'ok'); } return lang; } } return currentLang; } // 10. DICTARE NOTĂ VOCALĂ PE PRODUS function handleVoiceNoteOnProduct(text) { const norm = normalizeText(text.toLowerCase()); if (!norm.includes('noteaza la') && !norm.includes('notează la') && !norm.includes('scrie la')) return false; const afterAt = text.replace(/not[eează]+\s+la\s*/i, '').replace(/scrie\s+la\s*/i, ''); const product = findProduct(afterAt.split(' ')); if (!product) return false; const noteText = afterAt.replace(new RegExp(normalizeText(product.name), 'gi'), '').trim(); if (!noteText) return false; if (!product.notes) product.notes = []; product.notes.push({ text: noteText, time: new Date().toLocaleString('ro-RO'), user: userProfile?userProfile.name:'' }); product.note_preview = noteText.substring(0,50); saveStockToFirebase(); renderStock(); speak('Nota adaugata la ' + product.name + '.'); setFeedback('💬 Notă adăugată la ' + product.name + ': ' + noteText, 'ok'); return true; } // 12. VOCE ISTORIC AZI function handleVoiceHistoryToday(text) { const norm = normalizeText(text.toLowerCase()); if (!norm.includes('ce am adaugat azi') && !norm.includes('ce am facut azi') && !norm.includes('istoric azi')) return false; const todayStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('ro-RO', {day:'2-digit', month:'2-digit'}); const todayLog = log.filter(e => e.time && e.time.startsWith(todayStr)); if (!todayLog.length) { speak('Nu ai facut nicio operatie astazi.'); setFeedback('📋 Nicio operație azi.', 'ok'); return true; } const inOps = todayLog.filter(e => e.type==='in').length; const outOps = todayLog.filter(e => e.type==='out').length; const msg = 'Astazi: ' + todayLog.length + ' operatii. VOCE TRANSFER ÎNTRE DEPOZITE function handleVoiceDepotTransfer(text) { const norm = normalizeText(text.toLowerCase()); if (!norm.includes('trimite la depozit') && !norm.includes('transfer la depozit')) return false; const product = findProduct(text.split(' ')); if (!product) return false; const qty = parseQuantity(norm) || 1; const depotMatch = text.match(/depozit\s+([A-Za-zÀ-ÿ\s]+?)(?:\s*$|\s+\d)/i); const targetDepot = depotMatch ? depotMatch[1].trim() : null; if (!targetDepot) { speak('Specificati depozitul destinatie.'); return true; } product.qty = Math.max(0, product.qty - qty); saveStockToFirebase(); renderStock(); updateStats(); addLog(text, 'TRANSFER OUT ' + qty + ' ' + product.unit + ' → ' + targetDepot, 'out'); speak('OK. PROGRAM FIDELITATE CU NIVELE const LOYALTY_LEVELS = [ { name: 'Bronze', min: 0, color: '#cd7f32', discount: 0 }, { name: 'Silver', min: 500, color: '#c0c0c0', discount: 5 }, { name: 'Gold', min: 2000, color: '#ffd700', discount: 10 }, { name: 'Platinum', min: 5000, color: '#e5e4e2', discount: 15 } ]; function getLoyaltyLevel(clientName) { const pts = getLoyaltyPoints(clientName).total || 0; let level = LOYALTY_LEVELS[0]; for (const l of LOYALTY_LEVELS) { if (pts >= l.min) level = l; } return level; } function showLoyaltyCard(clientName) { const level = getLoyaltyLevel(clientName); const pts = getLoyaltyPoints(clientName); const nextLevel = LOYALTY_LEVELS.find(l => l.min > (pts.total||0)); const toNext = nextLevel ? nextLevel.min - (pts.total||0) : 0; alert('💎 ' + clientName + ' Nivel: ' + level.name + ' Puncte: ' + (pts.points||0) + ' Valoare totală: ' + (pts.total||0) + ' RON Discount: ' + level.discount + '%' + (toNext>0?' Până la ' + nextLevel.name + ': mai ' + toNext + ' RON':'')); } // 16. COMANDĂ RECURENTĂ CLIENT let recurringClientOrders = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sv_recurring_orders') || '[]'); function addRecurringClientOrder(clientName, cartItems, intervalDays) { recurringClientOrders.push({ id: Date.now(), clientName, cartItems, intervalDays, lastRun: null, active: true, created: new Date().toISOString() }); localStorage.setItem('sv_recurring_orders', JSON.stringify(recurringClientOrders)); setFeedback('✅ Comandă recurentă creată pentru ' + clientName + ' la fiecare ' + intervalDays + ' zile', 'ok'); } function checkRecurringClientOrders() { const today = new Date(); let processed = 0; recurringClientOrders.filter(o => o.active).forEach(order => { const lastRun = order.lastRun ? new Date(order.lastRun) : new Date(0); if ((today - lastRun) / 86400000 >= order.intervalDays) { order.cartItems.forEach(item => { const p = stock.find(s => s.id === item.productId); if (p && p.qty >= item.qty) { p.qty -= item.qty; addLog('Recurent: ' + order.clientName, 'OUT ' + item.qty + ' ' + item.unit + ' ' + item.name, 'out', order.clientName); } }); order.lastRun = today.toISOString(); processed++; } }); if (processed > 0) { localStorage.setItem('sv_recurring_orders', JSON.stringify(recurringClientOrders)); saveStockToFirebase(); renderStock(); updateStats(); setFeedback(processed + ' comenzi recurente procesate!', 'ok'); } } setInterval(function(){ if(typeof checkRecurringClientOrders==='function') checkRecurringClientOrders(); }, 3600000); // 17. AI CLASIFICARE LA IMPORT EXCEL async function aiClassifyImportedProducts(products) { if (!products || !products.length) return products; const cats = [...new Set(stock.map(p=>p.cat||'General'))].slice(0,10).join(', '); try { const resp = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens: 400, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Categorizeaza aceste produse de depozit in categoriile existente: ' + cats + '. AI DETECTARE ANOMALIE PREȚ async function aiDetectPriceAnomaly(product, newPrice) { if (!newPrice) return; const avgPrice = stock.filter(p => (p.cat||'')===product.cat && p.price_buy && p.id!==product.id) .reduce((s,p,_,arr) => s + p.price_buy/arr.length, 0); if (avgPrice === 0) return; const deviation = Math.abs(newPrice - avgPrice) / avgPrice * 100; if (deviation > 50) { triggerAlert('⚠️ Anomalie preț: ' + product.name + ' — ' + newPrice + ' RON vs medie ' + avgPrice.toFixed(2) + ' RON (diferență ' + deviation.toFixed(0) + '%)', 'warn'); speak('Atentie! 'vara' : month >= 11 || month <= 1 ? 'iarna' : month >= 2 && month <= 4 ? 'primavara' : 'toamna'; return product.seasonal_mins[season] || product.min; } function setSeasonalMins(productId, vara, iarna, primavara, toamna) { const p = stock.find(s => s.id === productId); if (!p) return; p.seasonal_mins = { vara: parseInt(vara)||p.min, iarna: parseInt(iarna)||p.min, primavara: parseInt(primavara)||p.min, toamna: parseInt(toamna)||p.min }; saveStockToFirebase(); renderStock(); setFeedback('✅ Minime sezoniere setate pentru ' + p.name, 'ok'); } function updateSeasonalMins() { stock.forEach(p => { if (p.seasonal_mins) p.min = getSeasonalMin(p); }); } setInterval(function(){ if(typeof updateSeasonalMins==='function') updateSeasonalMins(); }, 86400000); // 2. PRODUS CU DATA FABRICAȚIE ȘI LOT let productLots = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sv_lots') || '{}'); function addProductLot(productId, lotNumber, manufactureDate, expiryDate, qty) { const key = String(productId); if (!productLots[key]) productLots[key] = []; productLots[key].push({ lot: lotNumber, mfg: manufactureDate, exp: expiryDate, qty: parseInt(qty)||0, added: new Date().toISOString() }); localStorage.setItem('sv_lots', JSON.stringify(productLots)); const p = stock.find(s => s.id === productId); setFeedback('✅ Lot ' + lotNumber + ' adăugat pentru ' + (p?p.name:'produs'), 'ok'); } function getProductLots(productId) { return productLots[String(productId)] || []; } function getEarliestExpiryLot(productId) { const lots = getProductLots(productId).filter(l => l.exp && l.qty > 0); return lots.sort((a,b) => a.exp.localeCompare(b.exp))[0] || null; } // 3. STOC CONSIGNAȚIE let consignmentStock = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sv_consignment') || '[]'); function addConsignmentItem(ownerName, productName, qty, unit, pricePerUnit) { consignmentStock.push({ id: Date.now(), ownerName, productName, qty: parseInt(qty)||0, unit, pricePerUnit: parseFloat(pricePerUnit)||0, soldQty: 0, added: new Date().toISOString() }); localStorage.setItem('sv_consignment', JSON.stringify(consignmentStock)); setFeedback('✅ Consignație adăugată: ' + productName + ' de la ' + ownerName, 'ok'); } function sellConsignmentItem(itemId, qty) { const item = consignmentStock.find(i => i.id === itemId); if (!item || item.qty - item.soldQty < qty) { setFeedback('❌ Stoc insuficient consignație!', 'err'); return; } item.soldQty += qty; localStorage.setItem('sv_consignment', JSON.stringify(consignmentStock)); const earned = qty * item.pricePerUnit; setFeedback('✅ Consignație vândută: ' + qty + ' ' + item.unit + ' ' + item.productName + ' · ' + earned.toFixed(2) + ' RON', 'ok'); } function getConsignmentReport() { return consignmentStock.map(i => ({ ...i, available: i.qty - i.soldQty, totalEarned: i.soldQty * i.pricePerUnit })); } // 5. COMANDĂ VOCALĂ ÎN LANȚ (fără "și") function handleChainCommand(text) { const norm = normalizeText(text.toLowerCase()); const inKW = ['adauga','adaugă','pune','baga']; const outKW = ['scoate','scade','ia','minus']; const hasIn = inKW.some(k => norm.includes(normalizeText(k))); const hasOut = outKW.some(k => norm.includes(normalizeText(k))); if (!hasIn && !hasOut) return false; // Match patterns like "10 M6 20 M8 30 M10" const parts = []; const matches = [...text.matchAll(/(\d+)\s+([A-Za-zÀ-ÿ0-9\s]+?)(?=\d|\.|$)/gi)]; if (matches.length < 2) return false; matches.forEach(m => { const qty = parseInt(m[1]); const productText = m[2].trim(); if (!qty || !productText) return; const product = findProduct(productText.split(/\s+/)); if (product) parts.push({ qty, product }); }); if (parts.length < 2) return false; const opType = hasOut ? 'out' : 'in'; parts.forEach(({ qty, product }) => { if (opType === 'in') product.qty += qty; else product.qty = Math.max(0, product.qty - qty); addLog(text, opType.toUpperCase() + ' ' + qty + ' ' + product.unit + ' ' + product.name, opType); }); saveStockToFirebase(); renderStock(); updateStats(); const names = parts.map(p => p.qty + ' ' + p.product.unit + ' ' + p.product.name).join(', '); speak('OK. ' + parts.length + ' produse actualizate: ' + names + '.'); setFeedback('✅ ' + parts.length + ' produse: ' + names, 'ok'); return true; } // 10. CONFIRMARE VOCALĂ CU ECOU let pendingEchoCommand = null; let echoConfirmMode = false; function processCommandWithEcho(text) { if (!appSettings.voice_echo) return false; const norm = normalizeText(text.toLowerCase()); if (echoConfirmMode) { echoConfirmMode = false; if (norm.includes('da') || norm.includes('confirma') || norm.includes('yes')) { if (pendingEchoCommand) { const saved = pendingEchoCommand; pendingEchoCommand = null; processCommand(saved.text); } } else { pendingEchoCommand = null; speak('Comandă anulată.'); setFeedback('❌ Comandă anulată.', 'warn'); } return true; } return false; } // 11. "CE AM VÂNDUT AZI?" function handleWhatSoldToday(text) { const norm = normalizeText(text.toLowerCase()); if (!norm.includes('ce am vandut') && !norm.includes('ce am vândut') && !norm.includes('ce a iesit') && !norm.includes('ce a ieșit')) return false; const todayStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('ro-RO', {day:'2-digit', month:'2-digit'}); const outToday = log.filter(e => e.type==='out' && e.time && e.time.startsWith(todayStr)); if (!outToday.length) { speak('Nu ai vândut nimic astăzi.'); setFeedback('📋 Nicio ieșire azi.', 'ok'); return true; } const summary = outToday.slice(0,5).map(e => e.cmd).join(', '); const msg = 'Azi ai vândut: ' + outToday.length + ' operații de ieșire. Ultimele: ' + summary + '.'; speak(msg); setFeedback('📋 ' + msg, 'ok'); return true; } // 12. VOCE CORECTARE NUMĂR let lastVoiceQty = 0; let lastVoiceProduct = null; let lastVoiceOpType = null; function handleVoiceCorrection(text) { const norm = normalizeText(text.toLowerCase()); if (!norm.includes('nu ') || !lastVoiceProduct) return false; const newQty = parseQuantity(norm); if (!newQty || newQty <= 0) return false; const diff = newQty - lastVoiceQty; if (lastVoiceOpType === 'in') { lastVoiceProduct.qty += diff; } else { lastVoiceProduct.qty = Math.max(0, lastVoiceProduct.qty - diff + lastVoiceQty); } saveStockToFirebase(); renderStock(); updateStats(); speak('Corectat. ' + lastVoiceProduct.name + ': acum ' + lastVoiceProduct.qty + ' ' + lastVoiceProduct.unit + '.'); setFeedback('✅ Corectat: ' + lastVoiceProduct.name + ' → ' + lastVoiceProduct.qty + ' ' + lastVoiceProduct.unit, 'ok'); lastVoiceProduct = null; return true; } // 13. COMANDĂ VOCALĂ GRAFIC function handleVoiceChart(text) { const norm = normalizeText(text.toLowerCase()); if (!norm.includes('grafic') && !norm.includes('chart') && !norm.includes('evolutie') && !norm.includes('evoluție')) return false; if (norm.includes('7 zile') || norm.includes('saptamana') || norm.includes('săptămână')) { if (typeof showTrendsAnalysis === 'function') showTrendsAnalysis(); } else if (norm.includes('luna') || norm.includes('luni')) { if (typeof showMonthlyComparison === 'function') showMonthlyComparison(); } else if (norm.includes('categori')) { if (typeof showCategoryPieChart === 'function') showCategoryPieChart(); } else { if (typeof showTrendsAnalysis === 'function') showTrendsAnalysis(); } speak('Grafic deschis.'); return true; } // 14. OFFLINE VOICE PROCESSING (local keywords) function processVoiceOffline(text) { if (navigator.onLine) return false; const norm = normalizeText(text.toLowerCase()); const inKW = ['adauga','adaugă','pune']; const outKW = ['scoate','scade','ia']; const isIn = inKW.some(k => norm.includes(normalizeText(k))); const isOut = outKW.some(k => norm.includes(normalizeText(k))); if (!isIn && !isOut) return false; const qty = parseQuantity(norm) || 1; const product = findProduct(text.split(/\s+/)); if (!product) { speak('Produs negasit.'); return true; } const opType = isOut ? 'out' : 'in'; if (opType === 'in') product.qty += qty; else product.qty = Math.max(0, product.qty - qty); // Save locally only localStorage.setItem('sv_stock_offline', JSON.stringify(stock)); saveOfflineOp('stock', stock); renderStock(); updateStats(); speak('Salvat local. MULTI-DEPOZIT TRANSFER CU VALIDARE async function transferBetweenDepots(productId, qty, targetDepotKey, targetDepotName) { const p = stock.find(s => s.id === productId); if (!p) return; if (p.qty < qty) { setFeedback('❌ Stoc insuficient pentru transfer!', 'err'); return; } if (!window.fbReady) { setFeedback('❌ Firebase necesar pentru transfer!', 'err'); return; } try { // Scade din depozitul curent p.qty -= qty; await saveStockToFirebase(); // Adaugă în depozitul destinație const targetRef = db.ref('depozite/' + targetDepotKey + '/stock'); const snap = await targetRef.once('value'); let targetStock = []; if (snap.val()) { targetStock = Array.isArray(snap.val()) ? snap.val() : Object.values(snap.val()); } const existing = targetStock.find(s => normalizeText((s.name||'').toLowerCase()) === normalizeText(p.name.toLowerCase())); if (existing) existing.qty += qty; else targetStock.push({ id: Date.now(), name: p.name, qty, unit: p.unit, cat: p.cat||'General', min: p.min, maxQty: qty*3, notes: [], note_preview: '' }); await targetRef.set(targetStock); addLog('Transfer → ' + targetDepotName, 'OUT ' + qty + ' ' + p.unit + ' ' + p.name, 'out'); renderStock(); updateStats(); setFeedback('✅ Transfer finalizat: ' + qty + ' ' + p.unit + ' ' + p.name + ' → ' + targetDepotName, 'ok'); speak('Transfer finalizat catre ' + targetDepotName + '.'); } catch(e) { setFeedback('❌ Eroare transfer: ' + e.message, 'err'); } } // 39. SCHEDULER TASK-URI let scheduledTasks = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sv_tasks') || '[]'); function addScheduledTask(name, hour, minute, action) { scheduledTasks.push({ id: Date.now(), name, hour: parseInt(hour), minute: parseInt(minute), action, active: true, lastRun: null }); localStorage.setItem('sv_tasks', JSON.stringify(scheduledTasks)); setFeedback('✅ Task programat: ' + name + ' la ' + String(hour).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(minute).padStart(2,'0'), 'ok'); } function checkScheduledTasks() { const now = new Date(); scheduledTasks.filter(t => t.active).forEach(t => { if (now.getHours()===t.hour && now.getMinutes()===t.minute) { const today = now.toISOString().slice(0,10); if (t.lastRun === today) return; t.lastRun = today; localStorage.setItem('sv_tasks', JSON.stringify(scheduledTasks)); try { if (typeof window[t.action] === 'function') window[t.action](); else eval(t.action); setFeedback('✅ Task automat: ' + t.name, 'ok'); } catch(e) { console.error('Task error:', e); } } }); } setInterval(function(){ if(typeof checkScheduledTasks==='function') checkScheduledTasks(); }, 60000); // 40. NOTIFICĂRI GRUPATE let notificationQueue = []; let notificationTimer = null; function queueNotification(msg, type) { notificationQueue.push({ msg, type, ts: Date.now() }); clearTimeout(notificationTimer); notificationTimer = setTimeout(function(){if(typeof flushNotifications==="function")flushNotifications();}, 3000); } function flushNotifications() { if (!notificationQueue.length) return; if (notificationQueue.length === 1) { triggerAlert(notificationQueue[0].msg, notificationQueue[0].type); } else { const summary = notificationQueue.length + ' alerte: ' + notificationQueue.slice(0,3).map(n=>n.msg.slice(0,30)).join('; ') + '...'; triggerAlert(summary, 'warn'); } notificationQueue = []; } // 41. EXPORT FORMAT SMARTBILL/SAGA function exportSAGAFormat() { const depot = userProfile ? userProfile.depot : 'Depozit'; const now = new Date(); const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString('ro-RO'); // NIR format (Nota de Intrare-Receptie) let nirContent = 'NOTA DE INTRARE-RECEPTIE '; nirContent += 'Furnizor: [Furnizor] Data: ' + dateStr + ' Gestionar: ' + (userProfile?userProfile.name:'') + ' '; nirContent += 'Nr. | Denumire | Cantitate | UM | Pret achizitie | Valoare '; nirContent += '-'.repeat(80) + ' '; stock.forEach((p, i) => { const val = p.qty * (p.price_buy||0); nirContent += (i+1) + ' | ' + p.name + ' | ' + p.qty + ' | ' + p.unit + ' | ' + (p.price_buy||0).toFixed(2) + ' | ' + val.toFixed(2) + ' '; }); const totalVal = stock.reduce((s,p) => s+p.qty*(p.price_buy||0), 0); nirContent += '-'.repeat(80) + '\nTOTAL: ' + totalVal.toFixed(2) + ' RON'; const blob = new Blob([nirContent], {type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href=url; a.download='NIR_StocVoce_' + now.toISOString().slice(0,10) + '.txt'; a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); setFeedback('✅ Export format NIR/SAGA generat!', 'ok'); } // 49. QR CODE PE FACTURĂ function addQRToInvoice(invoiceNo, data) { if (typeof QRCode === 'undefined') { setFeedback('QRCode library necesară!', 'warn'); return; } const container = document.createElement('div'); container.id = 'temp-qr-' + Date.now(); container.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:-9999px'; document.body.appendChild(container); new QRCode(container, { text: JSON.stringify({ invoice: invoiceNo, depot: userProfile?userProfile.depot:'', ts: new Date().toISOString(), ...data }), width: 80, height: 80 }); setTimeout(() => { container.remove(); }, 5000); setFeedback('✅ QR cod generat pentru factura ' + invoiceNo, 'ok'); } // 50. SHORTCUT-URI VOCALE RAPIDE const VOICE_SHORTCUTS = { 'status': () => { if(typeof aiDailySummaryVocal==='function') aiDailySummaryVocal(); }, 'raport': () => { if(typeof exportTelegramWithDetails==='function') exportTelegramWithDetails(); }, 'audit': () => { if(typeof aiFullDepotAudit==='function') aiFullDepotAudit(); }, 'backup': () => { if(typeof doManualBackup==='function') doManualBackup(); }, 'bani': () => { const val = typeof calculateStockValue==='function' ? calculateStockValue() : {totalBuy:0}; const msg = 'Valoare stoc: ' + parseFloat(val.totalBuy||0).toFixed(0) + ' lei.'; speak(msg); setFeedback('💰 ' + msg, 'ok'); }, 'critic': () => { const n = stock.filter(p=>p.qty<=p.min).length; const msg = n + ' produse critice.'; speak(msg); setFeedback('⚠️ ' + msg, n>0?'warn':'ok'); } }; function handleVoiceShortcut(text) { const norm = normalizeText(text.toLowerCase().trim()); for (const [keyword, action] of Object.entries(VOICE_SHORTCUTS)) { if (norm === normalizeText(keyword) || norm === 'stoc ' + normalizeText(keyword)) { action(); return true; } } return false; } // 26.
